name: Small-Break Loss of Coolant Accident
description: A small break opens in the reactor coolant system. Primary pressure and pressurizer level fall despite full charging; the reactor trips on low pressurizer level, safety injection actuates automatically on low primary pressure, coolant is released into containment and containment pressure rises. The operator confirms the safeguards line-up and monitors containment.
briefing: You are at ~100% power. At t+30 s a small primary break develops. Verify the automatic response: low-pressurizer-level reactor trip, low-pressure safety injection, containment phase-A isolation. Confirm accumulator and high-head SI flow, watch boron rise, and keep containment pressure in view. Acknowledge alarms as they arrive.
learning_objectives: Recognise a loss-of-coolant event from falling pressure and level with rising charging demand
Follow the safeguards sequence: reactor trip -> safety injection -> containment isolation
Understand passive accumulator injection versus powered high-head SI
Track the fission-product barriers: fuel, primary boundary, containment
